1.

Our Father, in Thy beloved Son Thy love has reached us; Since He was exalted on Thy throne An eternal day has dawned.

2.

In Him, who died and now lives, We live before Thee. And together we will praise highly Thy immeasurable grace.

3.

Thou rejoicest when as sons we Raise the sound of praise, For this song of praise is led by Thine own Son, O God.

4.

Thy love, Father, is our portion, Thou hast foreseen us And for Thine own glory’s sake Made one with Christ.
